title: Smooth muscle (oesophagus)
description: The muscle coat (muscularis externa) of the oesophagus: bundles of smooth muscle cut lengthways and across.
look_for: Smooth muscle cells: spindle-shaped, with one central, elongated nucleus
Cells cut across: small round profiles, only some of which contain a nucleus
Two layers whose bundles run in different directions (one cut lengthways, the other across)
Between the layers: connective tissue, blood vessels and a ganglion of the myenteric (Auerbach’s) plexus

labels.text: Myenteric (Auerbach’s) plexus: a ganglion with nerve cell bodies
labels.find: a ganglion of the myenteric plexus

labels.text: Connective tissue between the two layers of muscle
labels.find: the connective tissue between the two layers of muscle
